title: Can you describe a useful finished result?
help: Name something you could inspect, such as a draft agenda with no invented decisions.
options: Yes, I know what I need

title: Can these inputs be used in the tool you would choose?
help: Consider permission, confidentiality and the service or account rules. Do not paste the material here.
options: I have checked permission and the tool rules
No, this material cannot be shared there

title: Would a wrong result be easy to catch and undo?
help: Use this guide for everyday, low-consequence tasks only. A decision affecting health, safety, rights, significant money or other people may need qualified review.
options: Yes, this is a low-consequence, reversible task
No, or I am unsure about the consequences

title: Can you check the important parts without trusting the same answer?
help: For example, compare against the original notes, recalculate independently, or use a reviewer with the right expertise. Asking AI to agree with itself is not that check.
options: Yes, a specific independent check is available
No, or the check is not arranged yet

title: Would a simpler method already do the job?
help: A search, checklist, spreadsheet formula or direct conversation may be enough. Include the work of reviewing an AI result in the comparison.
options: Yes, a simpler method is adequate
No, there is a specific reason to try AI

title: Would AI only prepare something for your review?
help: Separate suggesting or drafting from sending, spending, deleting, publishing or making commitments.
options: Yes, it would produce a draft or suggestions only
No, it would also act or change something
